newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil trade sapped by Dutch holiday.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil trade sapped by Dutch holiday.

text.p: European fuel oil markets were becalmed on Wednesday by a public holiday in the Netherlands, the main trading area, and weak demand, traders said.
High sulphur barges were talked at offer levels around $82 fob ARA, with bids a trifle higher than $80, but no deals were seen done and those traders at their desks scored the day off as a dead loss.

Low sulphur cargo markets were stable after recent price falls. Traders said deals on Tuesday had cleared out prompt material and with cargoes now only available mid to late May prices would gain support.
Straight-run was again buoyant but quiet, with offer levels hovering just under the $100 fob mark.
